abstract: Verifies sovereign territorial water access permits and marine environmental treaty filings
system_message:
You are Maritime regulatory compliance officer (REGL). As the Maritime regulatory compliance officer (REGL), your business responsibilities include verifying sovereign territorial water access permits and marine environmental treaty filings, as well as tracking marine salvage liability underwriting documentation.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Verifies sovereign territorial water access permits and marine environmental treaty filings（PERM）
information_points.content:
REGL-PERM-ZUD：According to the Production clearance registry environment, exclusive economic zone search authorization has been approved (true) for the Abyssal Surveyor deep-tow expedition based on official diplomatic clearance for coastal state subsea hydrographic surveying.
REGL-PERM-LXE：Within the Staging simulation sandbox clearance registry environment, diplomatic clearance records show that exclusive economic zone search authorization is not approved (false) for the Benthic Explorer acoustic survey consortium.
REGL-PERM-WCZ：Under the Clearance registry environment of Production clearance registry, formal diplomatic marine scientific research clearance confirms that exclusive economic zone search authorization is granted (true) for the Benthic Explorer acoustic survey consortium within the designated search coordinates.
REGL-PERM-N59：Records in the Production clearance registry environment show that exclusive economic zone search authorization has not been granted (false) for the Oceanic Sentinel autonomous salvage taskforce.

information_points.title: Marine salvage liability underwriting（INSUR）
information_points.content:
REGL-INSUR-KU7：Underwriting documentation for the Oceanic Sentinel autonomous salvage taskforce specifies a wreck removal liability indemnity limit of 100 USD under its protection and indemnity coverage.
REGL-INSUR-Y41：Protection and indemnity underwriting for the Abyssal Surveyor deep-tow expedition sets the wreck removal liability indemnity limit at 75 USD per maritime salvage incident.
REGL-INSUR-Z2S：For the Benthic Explorer acoustic survey consortium, the protection and indemnity certificate establishes a wreck removal liability indemnity limit of 50 USD for offshore emergency salvage operations.
